document.title: Rotating the OpenRouter key
document.excerpt: 1. Create a new key in the dashboard. 2. Update OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the secret store. 3. Restart the workers. 4. Revoke the old key after one hour.

concept.description: Pinning the model version keeps thresholds valid.
concept.body: Thresholds are tuned against one model version. When an alias moves to a new version, old thresholds may no longer fit, so we pin typesafe/jev-1.13.
